remarks:
Just steps from Lake Erie, this charming ranch offers an opportunity to enjoy the relaxed
lakeside lifestyle in Hamburg’s desirable Cloverbank community. A prior home
inspection identified significant issues within the crawl space, which buyers should
carefully evaluate when considering the property and any necessary repairs. For those
prepared to take on these concerns, the home offers possibilities in a convenient
location near the water. With approximately 876 square feet of living space, the layout
brings together comfort, simplicity, and everyday convenience. Step inside to find a
bright and inviting living area that flows easily into the kitchen, creating a welcoming
space for everyday living and entertaining. The property features a spacious bedroom,
full bath, and a nice-size laundry room offering additional storage and convenience.
Flexible living space also provides the possibility of a second bedroom, office, or hobby
area depending on your needs. Just moments from Lake Erie, you can enjoy refreshing
lake breezes and the stunning sunsets that Western New Yorkers treasure. The
neighborhood offers convenient access to local shops, restaurants, parks, and
everything that makes Hamburg such a special place to call home. Whether you
envision a year-round residence or weekend getaway, this property offers the
opportunity to make it your own while planning for the work needed.
